name: mywb-windows
description: Read and adjust the Western blot document open in MyWB.

interface.shortDescription: Read and adjust the Western blot document open in MyWB.
interface.longDescription:
Lets an assistant work in the MyWB window you have open: read the documents
and look at the window, set the ROI, label markers and samples, edit the band
table, adjust images and fluorescent channels, run Auto Detect, arrange panels
into a figure, style it, quantify lanes, and save and export.

MyWB has to be running with `AI assistant access` switched on -- the AI button
beside `Copy SVG for PowerPoint`. It is a Premium feature and is off by
default. MyWB listens on 127.0.0.1 only, and every request carries an access
token regenerated each time it starts. MyWB itself does not send your document
or images off your computer. However, it does pass them to the AI assistant on
your computer, and the assistant may send them on to its company's servers, as
Claude and ChatGPT do. The Privacy Policy lists what MyWB hands over.

Every change an assistant makes lands as one step in the Edit menu, so Ctrl+Z
takes back one action at a time. It saves to a new name and exports by
itself, and saves over a file it made itself in that window until anything
else writes to it. Writing over any other file, moving a file to the Trash
and discarding unsaved work wait for your answer in MyWB's own window, unless
you have set them to Allow without asking.
